svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat, 186 wide x 205 tall x 3 mm, ASA, enclosed printer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm holes 10 in from each side and from top and bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (166 x 185 apart) to match the box's four moulded bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure your box's bosses first and move the holes to suit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out on the front face, measured from the left and bottom edges:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: battery tray 8 to 88 across, 18 to 148 up; two 3.4 mm holes at 63

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across, 28 and 125 up, for its M3 x 8 screws and nuts;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each board's holes through the board; drill 3.2 mm for M3

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M4 screws into the bosses; the plate sits 6 off the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wall and 37 above the floor, clear of the gland nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 0.5 mm; drops in and lifts out without force.
